verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹת֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā yiṣ·ḥāq ’el- ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯōw way·ṣaw·wê·hū way·yō·mer lōw lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: So Isaac . . . called for Jacob and blessed him Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women he commanded . . .
verses.literalPt: Isaque, pois, chamou a Jacó, deu-lhe a sua bênção e ordenou-lhe, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher dentre as filhas de Canaã.

verses.original: ק֥וּם לֵךְ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם בֵּ֥יתָה בְתוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ וְקַח־ לְךָ֤ מִשָּׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: qūm lêḵ pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām bê·ṯāh ḇə·ṯū·’êl ’ă·ḇî ’im·me·ḵā wə·qaḥ- lə·ḵā miš·šām ’iš·šāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ lā·ḇān ’ă·ḥî ’im·me·ḵā
verses.literal: Go at once to Paddan-aram to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban your mother’s brother
verses.literalPt: Levanta-te, vai a Padã-Arã, à casa de Betuel, pai de tua mãe; e toma de lá uma mulher das filhas de Labão, irmão de tua mãe.

verses.original: וְאֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְיַפְרְךָ֖ וְיַרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ לִקְהַ֥ל עַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl šad·day yə·ḇā·rêḵ ’ō·ṯə·ḵā wə·yap̄·rə·ḵā wə·yar·be·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā liq·hal ‘am·mîm
verses.literal: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you so that you may become a company of peoples
verses.literalPt: Deus Todo-Poderoso te abençoe, te faça frutificar e te multiplique, para que venhas a ser uma multidão de povos;

verses.original: וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ בִּרְכַּ֣ת אַבְרָהָ֔ם לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֣ אִתָּ֑ךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yit·ten- lə·ḵā ’eṯ- bir·kaṯ ’aḇ·rā·hām lə·ḵā ū·lə·zar·‘ă·ḵā ’it·tāḵ lə·riš·tə·ḵā ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ mə·ḡu·re·ḵā ’ă·šer- nā·ṯan ’ĕ·lō·hîm lə·’aḇ·rā·hām
verses.literal: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants . . . so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner the land God gave to Abraham
verses.literalPt: e te dê a bênção de Abraão, a ti e à tua posteridade contigo, para que herdes a terra das tuas peregrinações, que Deus deu a Abraão.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֑ם אֶל־ לָבָ֤ן בֶּן־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י אֲחִ֣י רִבְקָ֔ה אֵ֥ם יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְעֵשָֽׂו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ way·yê·leḵ pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām ’el- lā·ḇān ben- bə·ṯū·’êl hā·’ă·ram·mî ’ă·ḥî riḇ·qāh ’êm ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·‘ê·śāw
verses.literal: So Isaac sent Jacob . . . to Paddan-aram to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean the brother of Rebekah who was the mother of Jacob and Esau
verses.literalPt: Despediu Isaque a Jacó, que foi a Padã-Arã, à casa de Labão, filho de Betuel, o arameu, irmão de Rebeca, mãe de Jacó e de Esaú.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֗ו כִּֽי־ בֵרַ֣ךְ יִצְחָק֮ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹב֒ וְשִׁלַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם לָקַֽחַת־ ל֥וֹ מִשָּׁ֖ם אִשָּׁ֑ה בְּבָרֲכ֣וֹ אֹת֔וֹ וַיְצַ֤ו עָלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ‘ê·śāw kî- ḇê·raḵ yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·šil·laḥ ’ō·ṯōw pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām lā·qa·ḥaṯ- lōw miš·šām ’iš·šāh bə·ḇā·ră·ḵōw ’ō·ṯōw way·ṣaw ‘ā·lāw lê·mōr lō- ṯiq·qaḥ ’iš·šāh mib·bə·nō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an
verses.literal: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there commanding him . . . Do not marry . . . a Canaanite woman
verses.literalPt: Vendo que Isaque tinha abençoado a Jacó e o tinha enviado a Padã-Arã, para tomar de lá mulher para si; vendo que, abençoando-o, lhe havia ordenado: Não tomarás mulher dentre as filhas de Canaã,

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶל־ אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֥נָֽה אֲרָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·ma‘ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ’el- ’ā·ḇîw wə·’el- ’im·mōw way·yê·leḵ pad·de·nāh ’ă·rām
verses.literal: and that Jacob had obeyed . . . his father . . . and mother and gone to Paddan-aram
verses.literalPt: e que Jacó, obedecendo a seu pai e a sua mãe, fora a Padã-Arã:

verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י רָע֖וֹת בְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן בְּעֵינֵ֖י יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ‘ê·śāw kî rā·‘ō·wṯ bə·nō·wṯ kə·nā·‘an bə·‘ê·nê yiṣ·ḥāq ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of . . . the Canaanite women
verses.literalPt: vendo também que as filhas de Canaã eram más aos olhos de Isaque, seu pai;

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶל־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֑אל וַיִּקַּ֡ח אֶֽת־ מָחֲלַ֣ת׀ בַּת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֲח֧וֹת נְבָי֛וֹת עַל־ נָשָׁ֖יו ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ ‘ê·śāw ’el- yiš·mā·‘êl way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- mā·ḥă·laṯ baṯ- yiš·mā·‘êl ben- ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ă·ḥō·wṯ nə·ḇā·yō·wṯ ‘al- nā·šāw lōw lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: Esau went to Ishmael and married Mahalath the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael in addition to the wives . . . he already had
verses.literalPt: Esaú foi à casa de Ismael e, além das mulheres que já tinha, tomou por mulher a Maalate, filha de Ismael, filho de Abraão, irmã de Nebaiote.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ חָרָֽנָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ya·‘ă·qōḇ mib·bə·’êr šā·ḇa‘ way·yê·leḵ ḥā·rā·nāh
verses.literal: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran
verses.literalPt: Jacó partiu de Berseba e foi para Harã.

verses.original: וַיִּפְגַּ֨ע בַּמָּק֜וֹם וַיָּ֤לֶן שָׁם֙ כִּי־ בָ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח֙ מֵאַבְנֵ֣י הַמָּק֔וֹם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·ga‘ bam·mā·qō·wm way·yā·len šām kî- ḇā haš·še·meš way·yiq·qaḥ mê·’aḇ·nê ham·mā·qō·wm way·yā·śem mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw way·yiš·kaḇ bam·mā·qō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: On reaching a certain place he spent the night there because the sun had set And taking one of the stones from that place he put it under his head and lay down to sleep
verses.literalPt: Tendo chegado a um certo lugar, ali passou a noite, porque o sol já se havia posto; tomando uma das pedras do lugar e pondo-a debaixo de sua cabeça, deitou-se naquele lugar para dormir.

verses.original: וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֗ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה סֻלָּם֙ מֻצָּ֣ב אַ֔רְצָה וְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ מַגִּ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יְמָה וְהִנֵּה֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים וְיֹרְדִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·lōm wə·hin·nêh sul·lām muṣ·ṣāḇ ’ar·ṣāh wə·rō·šōw mag·gî·a‘ haš·šā·mā·yə·māh wə·hin·nêh mal·’ă·ḵê ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘ō·lîm wə·yō·rə·ḏîm bōw
verses.literal: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven . . . and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder
verses.literalPt: Sonhou, e eis posta sobre a terra uma escada cujo topo chegava ao céu; os anjos de Deus subiam e desciam por ela.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב עָלָיו֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔יךָ וֵאלֹהֵ֖י יִצְחָ֑ק הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ שֹׁכֵ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ לְךָ֥ אֶתְּנֶ֖נָּה וּלְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh Yah·weh niṣ·ṣāḇ ‘ā·lāw way·yō·mar ’ă·nî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’aḇ·rā·hām ’ā·ḇî·ḵā wê·lō·hê yiṣ·ḥāq hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer ’at·tāh šō·ḵêḇ ‘ā·le·hā lə·ḵā ’et·tə·nen·nāh ū·lə·zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying I am the LORD the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Perto dele estava Jeová, que disse: Eu sou Jeová, Deus de teu pai Abraão, e Deus de Isaque. A terra em que estás deitado, ta darei a ti e à tua posteridade;

verses.original: וְהָיָ֤ה זַרְעֲךָ֙ כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ֛ יָ֥מָּה וָקֵ֖דְמָה וְצָפֹ֣נָה וָנֶ֑גְבָּה וְנִבְרֲכ֥וּ בְךָ֛ כָּל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָאֲדָמָ֖ה וּבְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh zar·‘ă·ḵā ka·‘ă·p̄ar hā·’ā·reṣ ū·p̄ā·raṣ·tā yām·māh wā·qê·ḏə·māh wə·ṣā·p̄ō·nāh wā·neḡ·bāh wə·niḇ·ră·ḵū ḇə·ḵā kāl- miš·pə·ḥōṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh ū·ḇə·zar·‘e·ḵā
verses.literal: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring
verses.literalPt: a tua posteridade será como o pó da terra, e te dilatarás para o Ocidente, e para o Oriente, para o Norte e para o Sul. Por ti e por tua descendência serão benditas todas as famílias da terra.

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י עִמָּ֗ךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲשִׁ֣בֹתִ֔יךָ אֶל־ הָאֲדָמָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֚י לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱזָבְךָ֔ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־ עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh ’ā·nō·ḵî ‘im·māḵ ū·šə·mar·tî·ḵā bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- tê·lêḵ wa·hă·ši·ḇō·ṯî·ḵā ’el- hā·’ă·ḏā·māh haz·zōṯ kî lō ’e·‘ĕ·zā·ḇə·ḵā ‘aḏ ’ă·šer ’im- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êṯ ’ă·šer- dib·bar·tî lāḵ
verses.literal: Look I am with you and I will watch over you wherever you go and I will bring you back to this land For I will not leave you until - I have done what I have promised you
verses.literalPt: Eis que estou contigo, e te guardarei por onde quer que fores, e te reconduzirei para esta terra; porque não te abandonarei até ter eu cumprido aquilo de que te hei falado.

verses.original: וַיִּיקַ֣ץ יַעֲקֹב֮ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָכֵן֙ יֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתִּי׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·qaṣ ya·‘ă·qōḇ miš·šə·nā·ṯōw way·yō·mer ’ā·ḵên yêš Yah·weh bam·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh wə·’ā·nō·ḵî lō yā·ḏā·‘ə·tî
verses.literal: When Jacob woke up . . . he said Surely the LORD is in this place and I was unaware of it
verses.literalPt: Despertado Jacó do seu sono, disse: Na verdade, Jeová está neste lugar; e eu não o sabia.

verses.original: וַיִּירָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מַה־ נּוֹרָ֖א הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֗ה כִּ֚י אִם־ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְזֶ֖ה שַׁ֥עַר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yî·rā way·yō·mar mah- nō·w·rā ham·mā·qō·wm haz·zeh ’ên zeh kî ’im- bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·zeh ša·‘ar haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: And he was afraid and said How awesome is this place This is none other than . . . the house of God this is the gate of heaven
verses.literalPt: E, temendo, disse: Quão terrível é este lugar! Este não é outro lugar, senão a casa de Deus, é também a porta do céu.

verses.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֔יו וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֹתָ֖הּ מַצֵּבָ֑ה וַיִּצֹ֥ק שֶׁ֖מֶן עַל־ רֹאשָֽׁהּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaš·kêm ya·‘ă·qōḇ bab·bō·qer way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- hā·’e·ḇen ’ă·šer- śām mə·ra·’ă·šō·ṯāw way·yā·śem ’ō·ṯāh maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh way·yi·ṣōq še·men ‘al- rō·šāh
verses.literal: Early the next morning Jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head and he set it up as a pillar He poured oil on top of it
verses.literalPt: Tendo-se Jacó levantado cedo de manhã, tomou a pedra que pusera debaixo da cabeça, pô-la por coluna e, sobre o topo dela, derramou azeite.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְאוּלָ֛ם ל֥וּז שֵׁם־ הָעִ֖יר לָרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’eṯ- šêm- ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū bêṯ- ’êl wə·’ū·lām lūz šêm- hā·‘îr lā·ri·šō·nāh
verses.literal: and he called - that place Bethel though previously the city had been named Luz
verses.literalPt: Chamou àquele lugar Betel; porém o nome da cidade antes era Luz.

verses.original: וַיִּדַּ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב נֶ֣דֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ יִהְיֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִמָּדִ֗י וּשְׁמָרַ֙נִי֙ בַּדֶּ֤רֶךְ הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ וְנָֽתַן־ לִ֥י לֶ֛חֶם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וּבֶ֥גֶד לִלְבֹּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yid·dar ya·‘ă·qōḇ ne·ḏer lê·mōr ’im- yih·yeh ’ĕ·lō·hîm ‘im·mā·ḏî ū·šə·mā·ra·nî bad·de·reḵ haz·zeh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî hō·w·lêḵ wə·nā·ṯan- lî le·ḥem le·’ĕ·ḵōl ū·ḇe·ḡeḏ lil·bōš
verses.literal: Then Jacob made a vow saying If God will be with me and watch over me on this - . . . journey and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear
verses.literalPt: Fez também Jacó um voto, dizendo: Se Deus for comigo, e me guardar neste caminho que eu vou seguindo, e me der pão para comer e vestidos para me cobrir,

verses.original: וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḇ·tî ḇə·šā·lō·wm ’el- bêṯ ’ā·ḇî wə·hā·yāh Yah·weh lî lê·lō·hîm
verses.literal: so that I may return safely to my father’s house then the LORD will be my God
verses.literalPt: de maneira que eu volte em paz à casa de meu pai, e Jeová for meu Deus,

verses.original: וְהָאֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֙מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’e·ḇen haz·zōṯ ’ă·šer- śam·tî maṣ·ṣê·ḇāh yih·yeh bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm wə·ḵōl ’ă·šer tit·ten- lî ‘aś·śêr ’ă·‘aś·śə·ren·nū lāḵ
verses.literal: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: então, essa pedra que tenho posto por coluna será a casa de Deus; e de tudo quanto me deres, certamente, te darei o dízimo.
